# Introduction

This document transforms a dataset that is not in the CWP format into the CWP format:
it first changes the structure of the data, then maps its codes to the CWP code lists.
It is generated from the function `gta_rawdata_iattc_effort_ps_byschool()` (`R/core/rawdata_iattc_effort_ps_byschool.R`), the code that the Global Tuna Atlas workflow runs.

The raw dataset is read from the `data/` folder next to this document, which holds the first
lines of each file under the name given by the tRFMO at export (this name may change).
A summary of the mapping is given at the end; the results are saved in the same folder.

*Knit the document from the repository (here::here() locates its root), or run it chunk by chunk.*

# The function


This function harmonizes the effort data for the IATTC PS BySchool datasets,
preparing them for integration into the Tuna Atlas database, following the required format specifications.
This script works with any data that has the first 5 columns named and ordered as follow: {Year|Month|SetType|LatC1|LonC1|NumSets}

@details This function modifies the dataset to ensure compliance with the standardized
         format, including renaming, reordering, and recalculating specific fields as necessary.
         Metadata integration is contingent on the intended use within the Tuna Atlas database.

@import dplyr
@import readr
@seealso \code{\link{FUN_efforts_IATTC_CE_allbutLLTunaBillfish}} for initial effort data preprocessing,
         \code{\link{IATTC_CE_efforts_pivotDSD_to_harmonizedDSD}} for converting effort data to a standardized structure.
@author Paul Taconet, IRD \email{paul.taconet@ird.fr}
@author Bastien Grasset, IRD \email{bastien.grasset@ird.fr}

@param data The raw dataset: a data frame, or the path to the file.
@return The harmonized dataset (data frame), as written by the geoflow action
  (iattc/effort/ps_byschool/action_iattc_effort_ps_byschool.R).

```{r}
# Packages the function uses unqualified, attached as in the workflow
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readxl) })
source(here::here('R/core/gta_data.R'))
gta_rawdata_iattc_effort_ps_byschool <- function(data) {
source(here::here("./R/sardara_functions/FUN_efforts_IATTC_CE_allbutLLTunaBillfish.R"))
  path_to_raw_dataset <- gta_path(data)
efforts_pivot_IATTC <-FUN_efforts_IATTC_CE_allbutLLTunaBillfish(path_to_raw_dataset,"NumSets","SetType","PS")

colToKeep_efforts <- c("FishingFleet","Gear","time_start","time_end","AreaName","School","EffortUnits","Effort")
source(here::here("./R/sardara_functions/IATTC_CE_efforts_pivotDSD_to_harmonizedDSD.R"))
efforts<-IATTC_CE_efforts_pivotDSD_to_harmonizedDSD(efforts_pivot_IATTC,colToKeep_efforts)

colnames(efforts)<-c("fishing_fleet","gear_type","time_start","time_end","geographic_identifier","fishing_mode","measurement_unit","measurement_value")
efforts$source_authority<-"IATTC"
efforts$measurement <- "effort"
efforts$measurement_processing_level <- "unknown" 
efforts <- efforts %>% dplyr::mutate(fishing_mode = ifelse(fishing_mode == "ALL", "OTH", fishing_mode))

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#@eblondel additional formatting for next time support
efforts$time_start <- as.Date(efforts$time_start)
efforts$time_end <- as.Date(efforts$time_end)
  efforts
}
```

# Harmonisation

```{r}
path_to_raw_dataset <- here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'iattc', 'effort', 'ps_byschool', 'data', 'PublicPSTunaSetType.csv')
georef_dataset <- gta_rawdata_iattc_effort_ps_byschool(path_to_raw_dataset)
write.csv(georef_dataset, here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'iattc', 'effort', 'ps_byschool', 'data', 'PublicPSTunaSetType_harmonized.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Mapping to the CWP code lists

```{r}
source(here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization/map_codelists_no_DB.R'))
fact <- "effort"
mapping_codelist <- map_codelists_no_DB(fact, dataset_to_map = georef_dataset, mapping_keep_src_code = FALSE, summary_mapping = TRUE, source_authority_to_map = c("IATTC", "CCSBT", "WCPFC"))
```

Unmapped values, then the results:

```{r}
georef_dataset <- mapping_codelist$dataset_mapped %>% dplyr::mutate(fishing_fleet = ifelse(fishing_fleet == 'UNK', 'NEI', fishing_fleet), gear_type = ifelse(gear_type == 'UNK', '99.9', gear_type))
# The summaries are NULL when nothing was mapped (e.g. tRFMOs not in source_authority_to_map)
if (!is.null(mapping_codelist$recap_mapping)) data.table::fwrite(mapping_codelist$recap_mapping, here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'iattc', 'effort', 'ps_byschool', 'data', 'PublicPSTunaSetType_recap_mapping.csv'))
if (!is.null(mapping_codelist$not_mapped_total)) data.table::fwrite(mapping_codelist$not_mapped_total, here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'iattc', 'effort', 'ps_byschool', 'data', 'PublicPSTunaSetType_not_mapped_total.csv'))
data.table::fwrite(georef_dataset, here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'iattc', 'effort', 'ps_byschool', 'data', 'PublicPSTunaSetType_CWP_dataset.csv'))
head(mapping_codelist$recap_mapping)
```
